category_title: Student with language impairment who uses loud noises and physical aggression to avoid tasks
student_description: Terrance is a 10-year-old with a language impairment who exhibits severe task avoidance (loud noises, refusal, physical aggression) when faced with difficult work and a lack of teacher attention. His history of academic failure means he uniquely requires highly frequent, specific performance feedback (e.g., 1-minute intervals) and carefully calibrated high-success tasks to maintain engagement and build independent work skills.

criteria.rationale: Because of his history of repeated academic failure, Terrance needs tasks he can complete with high accuracy (80%+) to build behavioral momentum and reduce task avoidance.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan includes assigning tasks that are matched to the student's independent success level (easy tasks) to build confidence.

criteria.rationale: Simply avoiding hard tasks permanently is ineffective; the goal is to gradually build his capacity to work independently.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term strategy includes a plan to build independent work stamina and provide assistance on hard tasks, rather than just permanently removing all challenging material.
